name: Hermes Agent
postCreateCommand:
set -e
LOG=/tmp/hermes_setup.log
exec > >(tee "$LOG") 2>&1
echo "STARTED $(date)"

# Wait for Docker daemon (DinD takes time to init)
echo "Waiting for Docker daemon..."
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  docker info &>/dev/null && echo "Docker ready after $((i*2))s" && break
  sleep 2
done

# Start Hermes Agent container
echo "Starting Docker compose..."
cd ${CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER:-/workspaces/7Kmcdashou}
docker compose up -d 2>&1
echo "Waiting 10s for container init..."
sleep 10
docker ps -a

# Install hermes-web-ui
echo "Installing hermes-web-ui..."
npm install -g hermes-web-ui 2>&1 | tail -5

# Start hermes-web-ui
echo "Starting hermes-web-ui on 8648..."
nohup hermes-web-ui start 8648 --no-open >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 5

# Port check
echo "Port check:"
ss -tlnp | grep -E "8648|9119" || echo "ports not found"

echo "COMPLETED $(date)"
echo DONE > /tmp/setup_complete
